actions.label: Context
actions.tooltip:
Print this script's context (frame, shot variables, and the rest).
No selection needed.

actions.label: Forced Geo
actions.tooltip:
Force Viewers to show real geometry instead of bounding boxes.
Click to turn on or off. The menu sets the expansion depth.
No selection needed.

actions.label: Connect Nodes
actions.tooltip: Connect, disconnect, insert, or merge the selected nodes.

hold.label: Connect
hold.tooltip:
Wire nodes in selection order (out to in).
Select 2 to 10 nodes in the order to link them.

hold.label: Disconnect
hold.tooltip:
Cut connections.
1 node: isolate it.
2 or more: remove links between the selection, including through a Dot.

hold.label: Insert Between
hold.tooltip:
Place a node between two others.
Select upstream, then downstream, then the node to insert.

hold.label: Merge Scenes
hold.tooltip:
Create a MergeScenes and connect each selected scene output.
Select 2 or more scene nodes. Order is in[0], in[1], and so on.
